topic: What if your strength doubled every day?

script.text: Monday. Your mum can't open the pickle jar. She hands it to you. Pop. Easy.
Tuesday. You close your bedroom door, and the handle comes off in your hand.
Thursday. Mo kicks the football onto the garage roof. You throw your schoolbag up to knock it down. The bag goes straight through the roof.
Saturday. The ball rolls under Dad's car. So you lift the car. With one hand. Dad drops his coffee.
Day ten. Mo goes for a high five, and you stop. Your hand freezes an inch from his. Because you know exactly what would happen if you touched him.
Every morning at six, when your alarm goes off, your strength doubles. It never stops. It never goes back. So what would actually happen to you if your strength doubled every single day?
